correctness.rationale: All 30 vertices and 45 edges are defined without external files. Enumerated shortest octagons=90; disjoint octagon pairs=1125. The unordered deleted-product has (435,1260,900) cells, and all signed boundary compositions and 1125 torus boundaries vanish. Sparse elimination over F101 gives rank 810 for the 900-column second boundary. The distinguished S6 orbit yields 90 independent integral cycles with an explicitly selected signed coefficient determinant -1. Hence the primitive rank-90 span equals the full integral kernel. Other three orbits have mod-two coordinate ranks (35,89,89), insufficient for integral generation.

value.rationale: This computes natural *minimum-length* geometric integral generators for a canonical nonplanar cubic girth-eight cage. Among four intrinsic symmetry-orbit families, exactly one is enough integrally, and a unimodular basis certificate explains saturation. The result answers a motivated toric-generation question for an extremal highly symmetric graph, not a routine numerical Betti computation. It may guide distinctions between toric generation and non-toric classes in other nonplanar graph configuration spaces.
